###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and let laurynmm follow up, since they gave the original feedback.

```quote
Thanks for updating the description! Issue #19589 already has an open PR (#38098) and is assigned to someone else, so please explain how your work relates to it, following our [guide on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html). Please also update the outgoing webhook docs to match your change and fix the broken code formatting in the description.
```
